text.text_excerpt: I've now tried every taco (and the quesadilla) and they are ALL amazing. Everyone from Dis Taco and Killer Poboys is super nice. My friend requested no cucumber, and she didn't get an eyeroll. The fish taco is perfect - the hibiscus slaw is out of this world! Also, I'm glad a friend shared her veggie/lentil taco. I never order veggie tacos when there's chorizo and lamb around, so this was an excellent surprise. In summary: SUPER AWESOME TACO DELICIOUS FOOD STORE.

This place just opened a couple of weeks ago. I read an article announcing its opening and really liked the premise ("If we can fold it, it's a taco") and the interesting combinations of ingredients that the article mentioned. Plus, it's inside one of my favorite bars in the Quarter. How could I not check it out? :-) Very interesting, unusual taco options (see the photo of the menu) that for the most part work very well. Each taco is served inside two small tortillas. Between my husband and myself, we tried: the coconut marsala and tamarind chutney taco (delicious, will definitely come back for this one), the citrus gulf fish one (I didn't have this one, but my husband said he loved it) a...

Just awesome, awesome, awesome. If you like non-traditional tacos (and if you like tacos...you should), this is the place to get them. It rivals my favoriate taco truck in the city in both style and taste. Dis taco is brought to you by the same lovely folks that brought us Killer Po Boys, and they applied the same creativity and taste to this new venture. The fact that it is located in the back of Molly's just makes it extra awesome. Your out of town guests will never expect the level of tacos they are about to receive, which will make the tacos taste extra yummy, and for you, you get to get tacos in a great chill bar. Now head over there and get some tacos, you will be glad you did!
